statement: N worker threads each write their own data and then count_down() once; waiter threads call wait(). wait() returns only after all N count_downs and then sees everything the workers wrote before counting down (no data race); once open, wait() returns at once; no thread is stuck forever.
contract: struct Latch { explicit Latch(int n); void count_down(); void wait(); };  single use; count_down is called exactly n times in total.
scenario_rule: at least three workers (so an early count_down's writes must travel through a later RMW) and two waiters
